text: {"status":"ANSWERED","claims":[{"text":"If you commit an API key to a repository, it must be revoked or rotated immediately.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"If a secret is exposed, for example committed to a repository or pasted into a chat, it must be revoked or rotated immediately"},{"text":"If you commit an API key to a repository, it must be reported as a security incident under the Incident Response Policy.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"and reported as a security incident under the Incident Response Policy."},{"text":"API keys are covered by this standard as secrets used to access Harbourline systems.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"This standard covers passwords, API keys, tokens, certificates and other secrets used to access Harbourline systems."},{"text":"Secrets must never be stored in source code or in configuration files committed to a repository.","evidence_id":"E4","quote":"Secrets must never be stored in source code, in configuration files committed to a repository, in tickets, in chat messages or in email."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":[],"conflict_note":""}
